says: In next/, the settings snapshot decodes its origins with Schema.decodeUnknownSync inside an Effect generator with nothing around it to catch the throw, so origins of the wrong shape crash as a defect and skip the typed error.
proof: Snapshot.ts:110 reads `origins: Schema.decodeUnknownSync(Schema.Record(Schema.String, Origin))(resolved.origins)` while building the snapshot inside a generator that then yields `hashValues(values)`; no `Effect.try` wraps it. Effect's own checker flags it as schemaSyncInEffect when that check is turned on (a count run of 2026-11-15 with every check on).
cost: A start with bad origins fails as an uncatchable defect, where the settings code answers a typed error for every other bad input.
